## 简体中文

- Slurm 作业列表新增日志图标，仅对自己正在运行的作业开放。点击后可在宽屏弹窗切换 `.out` 和 `.err`。训练进度逐行显示，超长行支持横向滚动。
- 勾选「跟踪日志」后，每秒读取新增内容并滚动到底部。应用会记住上次选中的日志类型和跟踪开关。
- 作业权重随列表一起刷新。列表显示完整用户名，便于在「全部」视图中识别自己的作业。
- macOS 提供 Apple Silicon 发行包，采用完整应用临时签名。发布流程会验证构建应用、DMG 和更新归档中的应用签名，并运行打包应用启动测试。

## English

- Add a log icon for your running Slurm jobs. Open the wide viewer to switch between `.out` and `.err`. Progress updates appear on separate lines, and long lines scroll horizontally.
- Follow a log to append new output every second and scroll to the bottom. The app remembers your selected output and follow setting.
- Refresh job priority with the queue and display full usernames so you can identify your jobs in the all-jobs view.
- Ship a full ad-hoc signed macOS package for Apple Silicon. The release workflow verifies the built app and the app inside the DMG and updater archive, then runs a packaged-app startup test.
